steps.title: Analyze Compiler Diagnostic Logs
steps.description: Reviewed compileDebugJavaWithJavac error pointing to SplashActivity.java containing a stray trailing timestamp marker.

steps.title: Clean SplashActivity Source
steps.description: Removed trailing log marker characters from SplashActivity.java to correct compilation issues.

steps.title: Analyze Build Script Dependencies
steps.description: Checked app/build.gradle for non-compliant third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Remove External Dependencies
steps.description: Removed NanoHTTPD dependency from app/build.gradle to comply with restriction rules.

steps.title: Refactor Manifest Declaration
steps.description: Removed package attribute from AndroidManifest.xml to align with latest Gradle namespace directives.

steps.title: Verify Main Activity Java Compatibility
steps.description: Ensured that MainActivity.java uses pure Java 8 syntax with anonymous inner classes instead of lambdas.

steps.title: Verify Splash Activity Java Compatibility
steps.description: Ensured SplashActivity.java uses pure Java 8 syntax with traditional anonymous inner classes.

steps.title: Validate Main Layout Grid
steps.description: Ensured activity_main.xml displays clean grids and elements using built-in SDK components.

steps.title: Validate Splash Layout Grid
steps.description: Inspected progress indicator properties in activity_splash.xml.

steps.title: Sanity Check Metadata Properties
steps.description: Ensured metadata properties are mapped correctly in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Initial Build Modern Calculator
steps.description: Executing build chain suite to compile, link and package the application artifacts before UI changes.

steps.title: Analyze Current Calculator UI
steps.description: Reviewed the existing `activity_main.xml` layout to understand its current visual state and identify areas for aesthetic enhancement.

steps.title: Define Modern Dark Color Palette
steps.description: Selected a new dark-themed color scheme using built-in Android colors for a sleeker and more cohesive appearance.

steps.title: Redesign Display Area Background and Text
steps.description: Updated the `display_text_view` in `activity_main.xml` with a darker grey background and vibrant orange text for better readability and a modern look.

steps.title: Apply Number and Decimal Button Styling
steps.description: Ensured all number buttons (0-9) and the decimal button have a consistent dark grey background with white text for a unified appearance.

steps.title: Apply Operator Button Styling
steps.description: Changed the background color of arithmetic operator buttons (`/`, `*`, `-`, `+`) to a distinct dark orange with white text for clear visual separation.

steps.title: Restyle Clear Button
steps.description: Updated the 'C' (clear) button's background to a darker red and maintained white text, making it visually prominent.

steps.title: Restyle Equals Button
steps.description: Enhanced the '=' (equals) button with a darker green background and white text, emphasizing its action.

steps.title: Adjust Button Text Sizes and Padding
steps.description: Reviewed and adjusted text sizes and padding for all buttons to ensure consistency, legibility, and a balanced layout.

steps.title: Final UI Layout Review
steps.description: Performed a comprehensive visual check of the `activity_main.xml` to ensure all new styles are applied correctly and the overall layout is aesthetically pleasing.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Executing build chain suite to compile, link, and package the application artifacts with the enhanced UI.
